mapper.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE dept_path (id, path) AS ( -- 起点: 顶级部门 (公司名称, parent_id=0), path 设为 NULL 不显示 -- CAST(NULL AS CHAR(2000)) 指定足够长度, 避免递归拼接触发 Data truncation SELECT id, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(2000)) AS path FROM rbac_department WHERE parent_id = 0 UNION ALL -- 递归: 子部门 path = 父 path 非空则拼接, 为空则直接用自己 -- CAST(... AS CHAR(2000)) 显式指定 path 类型, 跟第一分支兼容 SELECT d.id, CAST(CASE WHEN dp.path IS NULL THEN d.name ELSE CONCAT(dp.path, '-', d.name) END AS CHAR(2000)) AS path FROM rbac_department d INNER JOIN dept_path dp ON d.parent_id = dp.id ) SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.user_type, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.created_at, COALESCE(u.department_id, ud_first.min_dept_id) AS department_id, dp.path AS department_name, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ur.role_id ORDER BY ur.role_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM rbac_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id) AS role_ids, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM rbac_user_role ur INNER JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id) AS role_names, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(up.position_id ORDER BY up.position_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM rbac_user_position up WHERE up.user_id = u.id) AS position_ids, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(p.name ORDER BY p.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM rbac_user_position up INNER JOIN rbac_position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE up.user_id = u.id) AS position_names FROM rbac_user u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MIN(department_id) AS min_dept_id FROM rbac_user_department GROUP BY user_id ) ud_first ON ud_first.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN dept_path dp ON dp.id = COALESCE(u.department_id, ud_first.min_dept_id) WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND u.username != 'developer'
AND (u.username LIKE #{keyword} OR u.nickname LIKE #{keyword} OR u.phone LIKE #{keyword})
AND COALESCE(u.department_id, ud_first.min_dept_id) IN
#{did}
ORDER BY u.id DESC

-- 单级部门直接关联用户 (不递归子部门, 不含 developer / super_admin) -- 兼容主部门 (rbac_user.department_id) 和兼职部门 (rbac_user_department 表) -- 用 UNION 合并两路, DISTINCT 去重 (一个用户可能同时有主部门和兼职部门, 都被该部门关联) SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.user_type, u.created_at FROM rbac_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.username != 'developer' AND u.username != 'super_admin' AND u.department_id = #{departmentId} UNION SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.user_type, u.created_at FROM rbac_user u INNER JOIN rbac_user_department ud ON ud.user_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.username != 'developer' AND u.username != 'super_admin' AND ud.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.user_type, u.department_id, d.name AS department_name, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM rbac_user u LEFT JOIN rbac_department d ON d.id = u.department_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
